command: Planner consumes the Tau handoff JSON contract and emits a bounded tau.dag_run_spec.v1 for orchestrator validation; this command-spec overlay does not execute providers.
Orchestrator must validate and execute only the planner-emitted tau.dag_run_spec.v1 within structured readiness, receipt, retry, and stop gates.
Schema-valid tau.dag_run_spec.v1 and planner receipt with scope, dependencies, provider declarations, retry budget, forbidden actions, receipt paths, and stop conditions.
Orchestrator accepts the schema-valid DAG spec or returns a BLOCKED handoff with specific contract gaps.
